name: Hair Salons

seo.title: Top-Rated Hair Salons in Sioux Falls, SD
seo.description: Compare hair salons in Sioux Falls with hours, phone numbers, reviews, and a local guide to finding the right stylist for your hair type and budget.

heroImageAlt: A stylist wearing gloves applies hair color to a client's hair in a modern salon with lit mirrors.
intro:
Finding a hair salon in Sioux Falls is easy. Finding the right one for your hair, your schedule, and your budget takes a little more thought. Whether you need a quick trim, a color correction, or a full styling overhaul before a wedding or reunion, the salons listed here serve customers across the city, from downtown lofts to the newer subdivisions out in Harrisburg and Tea.

Sioux Falls hard water is genuinely rough on color-treated and chemically processed hair, so a stylist who understands that and can recommend the right products makes a real difference. The best salons here combine skill with honest communication about what your hair can and cannot do.
tips: Ask whether the stylist has experience with your specific hair texture, whether that is coarse, fine, curly, or color-treated, before you book.
Check whether the salon uses appointment scheduling software that sends reminders, so you are not left waiting or guessing about your slot.
Ask what water filtration or treatment products the salon uses, since Sioux Falls tap water is hard and can dull color and dry out hair over time.
Look for a stylist who offers a brief consultation before picking up the scissors, especially if you are describing a big change or bringing in a reference photo.

faqs.q: How much does a haircut cost at a salon in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: Prices vary widely depending on the salon, the stylist's experience level, and the length and thickness of your hair. A basic cut at a mid-range salon typically costs more than a walk-in chain but includes a more personalized experience. Call ahead or check the salon's website for current pricing, since rates change and menus vary.

faqs.q: Do Sioux Falls hair salons take walk-ins or do I need an appointment?
faqs.a: It depends on the salon. Some operate entirely by appointment, while others hold a few spots open for walk-ins each day. Calling ahead is always the safest approach, especially on Fridays and Saturdays when demand is highest.

faqs.q: How do I find a good stylist for curly hair in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: Look for a stylist who specifically mentions curly or textured hair experience on their profile or salon bio. Ask whether they use a curl-specific cutting technique, such as cutting hair dry, and whether they carry curl-friendly product lines. A consultation before your first appointment is a good way to judge whether the stylist actually listens to what your curls need.

faqs.q: How often should I get my hair colored if I go to a salon in Sioux Falls?
faqs.a: Most stylists recommend touch-ups every four to eight weeks depending on how fast your hair grows and how much contrast exists between your natural color and the dye. Hard water can cause color to fade faster here, so ask your stylist about toning treatments or at-home products that protect your investment between visits.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first appointment at a new salon?
faqs.a: Reference photos are genuinely helpful, so save a few to your phone before you go. Be ready to describe your daily routine, how much time you spend styling, and any chemical treatments your hair has had recently. That information helps your stylist make realistic recommendations rather than promises your hair cannot keep.

faqs.q: Are there hair salons in Sioux Falls that specialize in natural or protective styles?
faqs.a: Some salons in the city do offer braiding, locs, and other protective styling services, but not all do. Search specifically for those services when browsing listings and call to confirm before booking, since availability depends on which stylists are currently on staff at a given location.
